help_texts.RUN_1: The machine lifeform known as Sartre lives in Pascal's Village and speaks in byzantine philosophical passages. Talking to him proved a frustrating—and fruitless—endeavor, so speak to his female admirers to learn more about him.
help_texts.CLR: Despite being rejected by Sartre, his followers made no attempt to see him for what he truly was. As Sartre also had no interest in understanding his followers, he began to question the overall meaning of the relationship.
help_texts.DONE: After visiting Sartre again, you learned that he left a letter behind before departing on a journey. He devoted himself to philosophy to the very end, never once taking notice of those who held affection for him.
help_texts.RUN_2: A woman in Pascal's village explained that Sartre has additional followers in the amusement park and desert. Find these two fans, then give their presents to Sartre.
help_texts.RUN_3: Sartre seemed rather...nonplussed about the gifts. Go tell the three fans how he responded.
help_texts.RUN_1_US: The machine lifeform known as Jean-Paul lives in Pascal's Village and speaks in byzantine philosophical passages. Talking to him proved a frustrating—and fruitless—endeavor, so speak to his female admirers to learn more about him.
help_texts.RUN_2_US: A woman in Pascal's village explained that Jean-Paul has additional followers in the amusement park and desert. Find these two fans, then give their presents to Jean-Paul.
help_texts.RUN_3_US: Jean-Paul seemed rather...nonplussed about the gifts. Go tell the three fans how he responded.
help_texts.CLR_US: Despite being rejected by Jean-Paul, his followers made no attempt to see him for what he truly was. As Jean-Paul also had no interest in understanding his followers, he began to question the overall meaning of the relationship.
help_texts.DONE_US: After visiting Jean-Paul again, you learned that he left a letter behind before departing on a journey. He devoted himself to philosophy to the very end, never once taking notice of those who held affection for him.

help_texts.RUN_1: A wrecked Goliath is resting in the city ruins. Gather the materials required to repair its damaged circuits.
help_texts.CLR: Use the gathered materials to repair the Goliath.
help_texts.DONE: With its circuitry restored, the Goliath became capable of limited speech. The data retrieved, however, was fragmented and of little use. Further repairs are necessary if more detailed information is to be obtained.

help_texts.RUN_1: Gather the required materials to gain more intel from the wrecked Goliath.
help_texts.CLR: Use the gathered materials to repair the Goliath.
help_texts.DONE: The Goliath—who was named Engels—thanked you for the repairs and handed over all machine-lifeform data in his possession. With a good amount of free time on his hands, he now looks forward to future conversations.
help_texts.FIN: Through his talks with 9S and 2B, Engels came to realize the severity of his sins. Already at the end of his life span, he decided that death would be the best option.

help_texts.DONE: The child has been brought back to the village, where he reconciled with his parents. Since the machines are cut off from the network, the mother doesn't know what her child is thinking. However, this makes the joy of learning to understand each other that much more fulfilling.
help_texts.RUN_1: A small child ran away from Pascal's village after an argument with his mother, who is now desperate for your help. Go to the city ruins and bring the child back in one piece.
help_texts.FAIL_1: You found the child, but failed to prevent it from being destroyed. Go tell Mom what happened.
help_texts.FAIL_2: The mother machine lifeform is devastated at her loss.

help_texts.RUN_1: You found a shack deep in the woods where animals are being cared for. When a machine lifeform riding a wild boar suddenly attacked, you had no choice but to fight back.
help_texts.DONE: As it turns out, the boar-riding machine lifeform acts as caretaker and steward to the animals of the forest. Though an animal-loving machine lifeform is indeed strange, it seems harmless. It should be safe to leave this shack behind.

help_texts.RUN_1: One of the moose in the care of the animal-loving machine lifeform has fallen ill. Search the commercial facility for a recipe that can cure the poor creature.
help_texts.CLR: Teach the recipe to the machine lifeform in the forest shack.
help_texts.DONE: Thanks to the medicine, the sick moose made a full recovery. The relieved machine expressed wonder that living animals can't simply be repaired as machines are, and also that they possess warmth that machine lifeforms lack.

help_texts.RUN_1: The animal-loving machine lifeform has another concern: A roving herd of animals from parts unknown is encroaching on its territory, injuring animals and taking over their land. Chase off the invaders and save the woodland creatures!
help_texts.RUN_2: The roving herd is under the command of an animalistic machine lifeform which roars as it charges at foes. Defeat the animals and their leader.
help_texts.CLR: Tell the machine lifeform in the forest shack that you've repelled the herd.
help_texts.DONE: The machine lifeform felt at ease knowing that the herd has disappeared. When you inform him that you had to destroy one of his kind, he seems unfazed.

help_texts.RUN_1:
You received a sudden mail from an unknown source, containing 3 coordinates. They seem to point at locations in the desert, the flooded city, and the forest.
Investigate the coordinates.
help_texts.DONE: There was a mysterious facility at the coordinates. You wonder why the sender of that mail wanted you to go there.

help_texts.RUN_1: Behind the waterfall in the forest, you find an elevator guarded by machines who have initiated a contest to determine their strength. Perplexed but intrigued, you decide to enter.
help_texts.RUN_2: Earn every rank in the contest.
help_texts.DONE:
By participating in the contest, you came to understand that these machines use combat to find meaning in their lives. 
Will their battle ever come to an end?

help_texts.RUN_1: You found a fishy Resistance member in the flooded city who was directing those with the right credentials to an underground arena where android gamblers bet on fights. Intrigued, you join the tournament in order to investigate it from the inside.
help_texts.RUN_2: Earn every rank in the underground fighting contest.
help_texts.DONE: During your investigation, you learned that these androids had developed an almost human capacity for cruelty, and began to see violence against machine lifeforms as a form of sport. You wonder what is causing this behavior. Is it hate, or some other kind of emotion?

help_texts.RUN_1: In a corner of the great desert, there is a group of machine lifeforms who claim to dwell in the spot where the true Masked People are chosen. Despite your uncertainty, you agree to undergo a set of trials to prove your worth.
help_texts.RUN_2: Surpass every trial of the Masked People.
help_texts.DONE: After completing the trials, the machine lifeforms recounted that long ago, on these same sands, there existed a kingdom of people who lived their whole lives wearing masks. They say they can relate to people who desperately need something to cling to in order to keep on living.

help_texts.RUN_1:
Once all facilities had been examined, you received another mail from the unknown source, containing coordinates for a location below the amusement park.
Go investigate!
help_texts.DONE:
The area below the amusement park contained the diary of Plato 1728. 
A bumbling failure of a machine, Plato 1728 despised conflict. After losing a close friend, he flew into a fit of rage, and started destroying everything in sight, friend and foe alike.
Now that he consists of nothing but memories, he watches out over the world, eternally contemplating the meaning of his existence.

help_texts.RUN_1:
In the city ruins, a machine lifeform called Father Servo devotes himself to training.
He is eagerly searching for a sparring partner against whom he can test his strength.
help_texts.FAIL_1: The training session with Father Servo ended in defeat. Rise to the challenge once more and overcome this ordeal!
help_texts.RUN_2: You emerged victorious from Father Servo's training, but he demanded parts as payment for his services. Go find the requested item.
help_texts.CLR: Give the gathered materials to Father Servo.
help_texts.DONE: In an effort to improve himself, Father Servo made an entirely one-sided promise about a rematch.

help_texts.RUN_1: Father Servo has enhanced himself using the parts you gave him. Go verify the results for yourself.
help_texts.FAIL_1: The training session with Father Servo ended in defeat. Rise to the challenge once more and overcome this ordeal!
help_texts.RUN_2: You emerged victorious from Father Servo's training, but he demanded parts as payment for his services. Go find the requested materials.
help_texts.CLR: Give the gathered materials to Father Servo.
help_texts.DONE: In an effort to improve himself to even greater heights, Father Servo made an entirely one-sided promise about a rematch.

help_texts.RUN_1: Father Servo has enhanced himself using the parts you gave him. Go verify the results for yourself.
help_texts.FAIL_1: The training session with Father Servo ended in defeat. Rise to the challenge once more and overcome this ordeal!
help_texts.RUN_2: You emerged victorious from Father Servo's training, but he demanded parts as payment for his services. Go find the requested materials.
help_texts.CLR: Give the gathered materials to Father Servo.
help_texts.DONE: In an effort to push himself over the top, Father Servo made an entirely one-sided promise about a rematch.

help_texts.RUN_1: Father Servo has enhanced himself using the parts you gave him. Go verify the results for yourself.
help_texts.FAIL_1: The training session with Father Servo ended in defeat. Rise to the challenge once more and overcome this ordeal!
help_texts.RUN_2: You emerged victorious from Father Servo's training, but he demanded parts as payment for his services. Go find the requested materials.
help_texts.CLR: Give the gathered materials to Father Servo.
help_texts.DONE: In an effort to reach the ultimate heights of strength, Father Servo made an entirely one-sided promise about a rematch.

help_texts.RUN_1: Father Servo has enhanced himself using the parts you gave him. Go verify the results for yourself.
help_texts.RUN_2: You emerged victorious from Father Servo's training, but he has yet to show you his true strength. Rise to the challenge once more—this time with your life on the line.
help_texts.DONE: Having ascended to the apex of his strength, Father Servo put everything on the line and lost. With your victory achieved, nothing remains but to reminisce about the excitable machine.

help_texts.CLR: The lost child thanked you for guiding her out of the desert and returned to Pascal's village.
help_texts.DONE: The sisters are together again at last!
help_texts.RUN_1: You have been asked to locate a machine's little sister who went to the desert to look for parts to repair the older sister. Find her!
help_texts.RUN_2:
You found the lost little sister machine.
Bring her back to Pascal's village.

help_texts.RUN_1: The Resistance camp tool shop can't make plug-in chips due to machine failure. As the owner has a bad leg, he needs someone to gather the necessary materials to fix his equipment.
help_texts.CLR: Deliver the required materials to the supply trader at the Resistance camp.
help_texts.DONE: The tool shop is back in business, and plug-in chip trading has resumed. Attempts to convince the shop owner to fix his leg with the remaining materials were fruitless, as he didn't want to lose the only original part he had left.

help_texts.RUN_1: A Resistance camp manager has been having some personal problems lately, so she can't concentrate on her work. Find a "box that makes music when you open it" to help her out.
help_texts.CLR: Deliver the rusty music box to the manager.
help_texts.DONE: The music box has been delivered to the manager. It seems she knew the android that used to own it, as all she could do was silently clutch it in her arms.

help_texts.RUN_1: Anemone has asked for help reclaiming the forest. Destroy the enemies at the intended camp site.
help_texts.CLR: Tell Anemone that the enemies have been vanquished.
help_texts.DONE: Peace has returned to the forest, and the camp has been safely established.

help_texts.RUN_1: Anemone seems to have recalled something upon hearing the name of A2, though she wants your help finding more information. But where to go?
help_texts._1_1RUN_1: Target locations have been marked on the map using energy signatures emitted during combat. Investigate A2's readings at the abandoned factory.
help_texts._1_1DONE: 2B and 9S found a data log on A2 at the abandoned factory. Keep investigating the energy readings to gain more information.
help_texts.CLR: All locations with energy readings have been investigated. Return to Anemone and hand over the data.
help_texts.DONE: Upon looking at the data, Anemone was sure that A2 was the android she knew. It turns out they fought together in the past, but the squad under A2's command was wiped out. When told that Command wanted A2 executed for desertion, Anemone was shocked beyond words.

help_texts.RUN_1: You found an exhausted Resistance woman in the city ruins who claimed to have been caught in a huge explosion. She has no memory of events before or after the shock, but does possess a broken Pod with her friend's final moments recorded inside. Hack into the Pod and recover the life log.
help_texts.RUN_2: After hacking the Pod, you learn that the woman's friend was killed by another Resistance member clad in a red hood. Head to the Resistance camp and catch the perpetrator...er, red-hooded.
help_texts.RUN_4: The person you found says the red hood was a present from a Resistance woman who's stationed in the desert. Go to the desert garrison and find where the red hood came from.
help_texts.RUN_5: You couldn't find the Resistance woman you were looking for in the desert garrison. According to a man there, she was last seen in the desert caves. Go there and search her out.
help_texts.RUN_6: According to the woman in the cave, who turned out to be Jackass, she bought the red hood from a red-haired Resistance woman—a description that sounded an awful lot like the amnesiac woman you met in the ruins. Go back to her and get the real story.
help_texts.RUN_7: The Resistance woman looked uneasy at the suggestion the hood originally came from her. She asked 9S to retrieve more of the life log from the broken Pod in hopes of finding the whole truth. Hack deep into the Pod's data bank and see what you find.
help_texts.DONE: Seeing more of the life log, the Resistance woman's lost memories came rushing back—it turns out she was a YoRHa Type E. Hiding her true nature, she blended in with the Resistance to rout out fugitives and traitors, with her final victim being a dear friend. Wracked with guilt, the Type E erased her own memory. The sudden return of this tragic memory ended up leaving her shaken and unstable.

help_texts.RUN_1: A woman at the Resistance camp claims that one of her friends is missing. Investigate the materials storage site and search for clues.
help_texts.CLR: Judging from the data found on the man and the machine, both tricked the other into coming here in order to exact revenge. Report your findings to the client.
help_texts.DONE: The client has been informed of your findings. Though overcome with grief at the loss of her friend, she seems to have some kind of plan...
help_texts.END: Check on the woman at the Resistance camp.
help_texts.FIN: The woman was nowhere to be found in camp, though a man claimed he saw her leave with a weapon in hand.
help_texts.RUN_3: Investigate the location at the coordinates inscribed on the storage site wall.
help_texts.FAIL_2: The door to the storage room was shut tight.
help_texts.RUN_4: Upon arriving at the coordinates, you found a dead Resistance member and a blood-covered machine lifeform. Examine the body of the Resistance member.

help_texts.RUN_1: Jackass is doing research on the excitement androids experience during battle. She needs combat data on a new enemy model, so head into the desert and start wreckin' machines!
help_texts.RUN_4: The required data has been obtained. Report to Jackass.
help_texts.RUN_5: The required data has been obtained. Apparently, the feeling of excitement experienced during combat is close to what humans call "love." Jackass is already figuring out what to do next.
help_texts.RUN_6: Jackass needs more detailed data. Defeat the target machines without taking any damage!
help_texts.DONE: The new drug was so good, those who partake of it find it hard to put down. ...Oh, and it also causes extreme mental instability. However, if you're curious, Jackass claims it can be obtained by talking to a Resistance member near the oil fields in the desert.
help_texts.FAIL_3: You failed to collect the data. Go back to Jackass and accept her request again.
help_texts.RUN_8: The required data has been obtained. Report to Jackass.
help_texts.RUN_10: Jackass needs even more detailed data. Defeat the target machines in 30 seconds.
help_texts.RUN_13: The required data has been obtained, and reveals that androids actually generate a pleasure-granting chemical while in combat. Jackass plans to use this knowledge to create a new drug that will expand androids' capabilities. Go see her again after some time passes.
help_texts.RUN_14: For the last batch of data, Jackass wants you to defeat the target machines in 30 seconds without taking damage!
help_texts.FAIL_7: You failed to collect the data. Go back to Jackass to accept her request again.
help_texts.RUN_9:
Jackass seemed very surprised that a YoRHa type, being specialized in combat, was capable of regular thought. According to her, normal thoughts only get in the way when you're trying to destroy things.
Jackass is already considering what to do next...
help_texts.FAIL_11: You failed to collect the data. Go back to Jackass to accept her request again.
help_texts.RUN_12: The required data has been obtained. Report to Jackass.
help_texts.FAIL_15: You failed to collect the data. Go back to Jackass to accept her request again.
help_texts.RUN_16: The required data has been obtained. Report to Jackass.
help_texts.RUN_17:
The results of the research indicate that androids generate some kind of comforting element in their circuits during combat. 
Jackass is going to use these results to create a new drug for expanding android functionality. Give her some time and go meet her again in a while.
help_texts.RUN_19:
The new drug is complete!
Go talk to Jackass.

help_texts.RUN_1: You've been tasked with transporting materials to the Resistance in order to improve communications between Earth and the Bunker. You'll be informed of the required materials when you arrive. Proceed to surface and wait for the Commander to contact you.
help_texts.READY: Acquire the below materials to improve communications with the Resistance camp.
help_texts.CLR: Give the materials to Anemone.
help_texts.DONE:
You received a reward from Anemone for completing the task. 
The reward was surprisingly significant, leaving you with complicated feelings.
help_texts.RUN_2:
The Operator has provided info on some materials. The required items can be obtained in the city ruins.
Acquire the below materials to improve communications with the Resistance camp.

help_texts.RUN_1: Command has lost contact with an access point. Go to the access point in the collapsed section of the city ruins and find out what's going on.
help_texts.DONE: You reported the restoration of communications in the target area. The Commander was shocked that machine lifeforms would lay a trap for androids in such a fashion.
help_texts.RUN_2: Machine lifeforms were hanging around the access point, and their jamming signals were interfering with communications. Interact with the access point to restore it.

help_texts.RUN_1: You heard from Operator 6O that an access point in the city ruins is malfunctioning. She'll send an email with further details. Read it, then repair the damaged access point.
help_texts.CLR: Several machines were hanging out near the malfunctioning access point. It seems their jamming signals were interfering with the device's functionality. Interact with the access point to make sure it still works.
help_texts.DONE: With the access point repaired, Operator 6O promised to share your newfound information with Command. She also showed great interest in the missions of attacker types, as well as life in general on the planet's surface. Make sure to claim the reward she sent via mail.
help_texts.FIN: You received mail from the Operator.

help_texts.RUN_1: Data from a rare flower would be a perfect gift for Operator 6O. Collect the following item in order to take the required photo:
help_texts.CLR: You found a desert rose. Take a picture and send it to Operator 6O.
help_texts.DONE: You received a reward from Operator 6O in thanks for the picture of the desert rose. She seems more infatuated with Earth now than ever, if such a thing is possible. Make sure to claim the reward she sent over by mail.
help_texts.FIN: You received mail from the Operator.

mails.title: Thanks for your help the other day!

help_texts.RUN_1: Operator 21O enjoys analyzing data in her spare time. You made light of her hobby and ended up being made to help with it. Go to the abandoned factory and infiltrate a data terminal that can't be accessed from the Bunker.
help_texts.CLR: You retrieved the data from the terminal. Go outside so you can make a proper connection, then upload your findings.
help_texts.DONE: Operator 21O informed you that the data you delivered contained ancient human diaries—and then ended communications in her usual curt manner. Make sure to claim the reward she sent via mail.
help_texts.FIN: You received mail from the Operator.

help_texts.RUN_1: The data-loving Operator 21O has forced another request on you. Check your mail for further details.
help_texts.CLR: You collected remnants of human society from the apartment complex, after which Operator 21O's analysis revealed that they used to live in groups called "families." Make sure to claim the reward she sent via mail.
help_texts.DONE: Operator 21O talked...and talked...and talked some more...before suddenly ending communications. Make sure to claim the reward she sent via mail.
help_texts.FIN: You received mail from the Operator.
help_texts.RUN_2: The mail contained a new request for intel gathering. Head to the apartment complex in the desert to find traces of humans' daily lives.

help_texts.RUN_1: A lone machine lifeform dwells in a gloomy canyon. She doesn't seem hostile, and was even willing to share information on machines that are rampaging nearby. Head further into the canyon and take them out.
help_texts.CLR: You destroyed the violent machine lifeforms. Go back to the machine lifeform who first told you about them.
help_texts.DONE: You informed the machine of your success. She has decided to remain behind and pray for the souls of her comrades.

help_texts.RUN_1: Pascal needs someone to defeat a machine lifeform that is attacking the children. Head to the playground and put an end to its rampage.
help_texts.CLR: Inform Pascal that you destroyed the machine.
help_texts.DONE:
Pascal is relieved.
You protected the children and the pacifistic machines in the village. Unfortunately, you also gained a lot of affection in the process.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.RUN_1: The children of the village are desperate for new playthings. Head to the local tool shop and see what you can do.
help_texts.RUN_2: Collect the required materials in the amusement park.
help_texts.CLR: The village has new play equipment! Go tell the kids!
help_texts.DONE: The overjoyed children give you a reward, though their sincere happiness fills you with complex emotions.
help_texts.RUN_3: Deliver a toy to the supply trader in Pascal's village.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.RUN_1: According to Pascal, a child in the village has fallen ill, and may not survive if you don't help her. Go to the abandoned factory and collect the needed part.
help_texts.CLR: Give the materials to Pascal.
help_texts.DONE: Pascal happily accepted the storage element. He clearly cares for the children very much, but to you, the reward is all that matters.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.RUN_1: An academic machine in a section of Pascal's village claims to be a genius inventor in search of an investor and asks you to make a contribution—for science, of course. Swallow your cynicism and open your pocketbook!
help_texts.DONE:
Thanks to your magnanimous investment, the self-proclaimed genius was ready to undertake the invention of a lifetime. After a while, a gigantic structure that reached beyond the limits of your vision appeared...a structure that was in truth a launching platform that could send its payload to the moon!

...Unfortunately, it never reached the moon. It missed and hit Mars instead, much to the inventor's chagrin.

help_texts.RUN_1:
Pascal claims that children in his village are made to study economics and numismatics. He urged you to speak with them and hear what they have to say on the subjects.
One of the machine children was offered a choice between a cheap coin or an expensive one. The child selected the cheap coin, much to the cruel delight of the others. Something might be the matter with the young robot's circuits, so hack into it to find out.
help_texts.DONE: Upon hacking the child, you discovered that his circuitry was capable of extremely complex operations. When you asked the child why it made such foolish decisions, he explained that acting stupid could be very profitable; as long as he asked for cheaper coins, he would keep earning them from his foolish fellows. After agreeing to keep his secret, you walk away with a few salient questions about the true nature of genius.

help_texts.RUN_1: A machine lifeform at the amusement park needs an item to create a game. The item can be obtained by defeating machines at the park.
help_texts.CLR: Bring the materials back to the machine lifeform.
help_texts.DONE: The machine lifeform at the amusement park used your materials to create a hacking game. He also offered you a prize if you find the bugs hidden in his game.
help_texts.FIN: 9S found the bugs in the hacking game. The thrilled creator happily handed over the prize.

help_texts.RUN_1: The game-creating machine at the amusement park needs more materials in order to make a more difficult game. Go to the abandoned factory and acquire a four-color cable from the soldier machines there.
help_texts.CLR: Bring the cable back to the machine lifeform.
help_texts.DONE: The machine lifeform at the amusement park used the item to create a second hacking game. It says it will give you a prize if you can find the bugs hidden in it.
help_texts.FIN: 9S found the bugs in the hacking game. The thrilled creator happily handed over the prize.

help_texts.RUN_1: The game-creating machine needs another item to create an even more difficult game. Go to the desert and acquire a five-color cable from the machines there.
help_texts.CLR: Bring the cable back to the machine lifeform.
help_texts.DONE: The machine lifeform at the amusement park used the item to create a hacking game. It says it will give you a prize if you can find the bugs hidden in it.
help_texts.FIN: 9S found the bugs in the hacking game. The thrilled creator happily handed over the prize.

help_texts.DONE: You won the third race. Feeling content, the machine lifeform shuts down for good.
help_texts.RUN_1: A machine in the city ruins has challenged you to a race. Reach the goal before he does!
help_texts.RUN_2: You won the race, but the machine is not done with you yet.
help_texts.RUN_3: The machine wants a rematch. Reach the goal before he does!
help_texts.RUN_4: You won the second race. But the machine is still not done with you!
help_texts.RUN_5: You're going to have a third race. Reach the goal before the machine!

help_texts.RUN_1: You happened upon Emil admiring the lunar tears around the commercial facility. He said they brought back memories, and also filled him with an emotion that he couldn't quite describe. He then asked you to find more lunar tears somewhere in each region, hoping that they might help him understand his feelings.
help_texts.DONE: After you found a wide space covered with lunar tears in the basement of the commercial facility, Emil appeared and told you of his life. He was built long ago as a weapon, and he himself was but one of many copies produced during the war against the aliens. He said that the place you were standing was very dear to the original Emil who had lived so long before. Your Emil then wistfully explained how echoes of that memory lingered on inside him.
help_texts.RUN_5: At last, Emil remembers everything—including a place that was very important to him. In gratitude, he offered to show you his special place and gave you a key to the elevator in the commercial facility. He will be waiting for you in the basement.

help_texts.RUN_1: A girl at the Resistance camp claims to have lost her memories in a battle, and can't remember the events surrounding some important images in her possession. Find the locations in the three faded photographs.
help_texts._1_1CLR: One of the images is from the desert. Give the coordinates and the restored photograph to the girl.
help_texts._1_2CLR: One of the images is from the amusement park. Give the coordinates and the restored image to the girl.
help_texts._1_3CLR: One of the images is from the forest. Give the coordinates and the restored image to the girl.
help_texts.DONE: Upon seeing the photographs, the girl slowly regains her memories. It turns out they were the last data her lover sent to her before dying in battle.

help_texts.RUN: You discovered a machine lifeform standing quietly high up in the ruins. Hack into it and investigate its strange behavior.
help_texts.CLR: The machine lifeform that stood up on the high spot threw itself off. Head to where it fell.
help_texts.DONE: Distraught after realizing it was created to be a weapon, the machine lifeform decided it was unneeded and leapt to its death.

help_texts.RUN_1: 16D has a request. Her instructor, 11B, died in battle at the abandoned factory, and her body was never recovered. Go to the abandoned factory and return with any mementos you can find.
help_texts.CLR: You found 11B's body. Bring her belongings to 16D.

help_texts.RUN_1: You heard from a resident of Pascal's village of a great treasure hidden in the forest. Go see if there is any truth to the rumors.
help_texts.RUN_4: Search for a door in the forest castle that matches the key.
help_texts.RUN_5: A rampaging machine has appeared. It looks like there's something ahead...
help_texts.DONE: The hidden treasure turned out to be storage media containing the forest kingdom's history, made by its machine lifeforms as a show of gratitude to the original Forest King. When you told this to the villager, he recalled a time long ago when he had been shunned by the kingdom's denizens for his strange speech. He was filled with delight that the grave's guardian had been destroyed, and he wished death upon the entire forest kingdom.
help_texts.RUN_7: Report to the machine in Pascal's village.

help_texts.RUN_1: In the flooded city, you met a Resistance trooper researching the local ecosystem in anticipation of humanity's eventual return. Find some white animals and bring them back for examination.
help_texts.RUN_2: The Resistance researcher still needs more mutated white animal specimens to examine. Go find another species with this abnormality and bring it back.
help_texts.DONE: The mutated specimens you recovered proved that the state of the environment is actually far better than previously believed. Considering that humanity's return might undo all of these gains, the researcher expressed doubt about what is truly best for the planet.

help_texts.CLR: Pascal fixed the female android, and the couple has reunited. They are also still insistent on resetting their memories.
help_texts.DONE: The female android was trying to modify the male android's personality to be more to her liking. This is the sixth time she's reformatted him.
help_texts.RUN_1: You met an android couple who fled from the Resistance to hide at Pascal's village. They abhor violence, and only wish to live in peace. Go to the abandoned factory to collect the following item in order to perform maintenance on the male android:
help_texts.RUN_2: Deliver the items to the android couple.
help_texts.RUN_3: You brought the male android the elaborate gadget. Apparently, they plan to leave Pascal's village as soon as the maintenance is done.
help_texts.RUN_5: You ran into the android couple again at the flooded city, and learned they are trying to flee beyond the sea. Give them 50,000 G so they can pay a man called "The Emancipator."
help_texts.RUN_6: The thankful couple vowed to repay the money you loaned them.
help_texts.RUN_7: Did they manage to get across the sea safely?
help_texts.RUN_8: Upon revisiting the flooded city, you find that the male android has been betrayed and knocked out by The Emancipator.
help_texts.RUN_9: The female android fled as a distraction, but should be somewhere in the amusement park. Go help her!
help_texts.RUN_10: You found the female android's heavily damaged body in the amusement park. Go to the city ruins and track down the following items to repair her:
help_texts.RUN_11: Deliver the items to the female android in order to repair her.
help_texts.FIN: The experience with the female android who wanted to modify her partner has taught Pascal that women can be scary.

help_texts.CLR: The information pertained to nuclear weapons from the old world. It could be dangerous in the wrong hands, so it might be best to hand it over to the Commander. Make a choice and deliver the intel to either Pascal or the Commander.
help_texts.RUN_1: Pascal asked you to collect information pertaining to the old world. Bring back any interesting tidbits that you find.
help_texts.RUN_3: Deliver the information on the old world to Pascal.

help_texts.CLR: Give the supply trader the requested ingredients.
help_texts.DONE: You gave the ingredients to the trader, who has learned that meat is delicious when roasted over a charcoal fire after applying salt. The trader is going to continue his research so that he can prepare a feast when the humans return.
help_texts.RUN_1: The shop owner in the forest is researching human cuisine, and he needs help gathering ingredients. Find the following:

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.RUN_1: The Commander has issued an emergency assignment: YoRHa units 8B, 22B and 64B have deserted and have begun terrorizing the Resistance Camp. 2B and 9S have been ordered to find and deal with them, no matter what. Pursue the runaway YoRHa androids.
help_texts.DONE: The camp leader is confused about the supposed rogue YoRHa units, as there haven't been any reports about recent raids. When attempting to notify the Commander of this, you find that access to the case has been restricted at the highest levels.
help_texts.CLR: You defeated the YoRHa fugitives. Talk to Anemone to find out what's really going on.

help_texts.RUN_1:
After the fall of the Bunker, 4S, a similar model android to 9S, has taken refuge at the Forest Castle.
Even though the YoRHa squad has been destroyed, he's still trying to gather data on the enemy, and since there's only so much he can do on his own, he has asked 9S for help.
Gather new enemy intel, and give it to 4S at the Forest Castle.
help_texts.DONE:
4S felt a sense of guilt at having survived when all of his friends had died. 
He is very grateful that the intel gathering was completed faster than expected, and he tells 9S not to succumb to the same sense of guilt. He decides to give serious thought to how he's going to live his life from now on.

help_texts.CLR: Give Devola and Popola the materials you collected.
help_texts.DONE: Devola and Popola thanked you for giving them the materials. It seems they've been putting their advanced technical knowledge to use...by making daily necessities for the camp.
help_texts.RUN_1:
Devola and Popola need some materials. Collect the following items from machines at the abandoned factory:
Stripped screws from machines that are stacked on top of each other.
Small gears from the little machines with short legs.
Machine oil from an abandoned truck.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.CLR: Take the desert roses you collected to Devola and Popola.
help_texts.DONE: You gave the desert roses to Devola and Popola. Now ask Anemone why they continually get asked to do difficult assignments.
help_texts.RUN_1: Devola and Popola need more materials. Collect the following items from the desert:
help_texts.FIN: You asked Anemone for an explanation, but she dodged the subject.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.CLR: Deliver the tree sap to Devola and Popola, and tell them you defeated the enemies.
help_texts.DONE: You received desert rose liquor as a reward, as well as the knowledge that Popola and liquor are a disastrous combination.
help_texts.RUN_1: Devola and Popola need some materials. Collect the following items from the forest:

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.RUN_1: A Resistance member wants help locating some relics from the old world—and since they're likely to be buried in sand, you'll need to use the dynamic scanner. Find them and bring them to the client.
help_texts._1_1CLR: You found an old staff. Deliver it to the client.
help_texts._1_1DONE: According to the client, the old staff was used in ancient desert ceremonies.
help_texts._1_2CLR: You found a stone tablet with laws written on it. Deliver it to the client.
help_texts._1_2DONE: According to the client, there used to be a country in the desert where people lived under an impossible number of rules.
help_texts._1_3CLR: You found a dirty mask. Deliver it to the client.
help_texts._1_3DONE: According to the client, all the people living in the ancient desert country used to wear masks.
help_texts.CLR: You found a statue of a young girl. Deliver it to the client.
help_texts.DONE: According to the client, the young woman is dressed as a bride, and hailed from an ancient desert country known as "Facade" where people spoke a strange language and had their own unique clothing and culture. This discovery seemed to satisfy his curiosity about the old world.
help_texts.RUN_2: Deliver the relics to the client.
help_texts.RUN_3: According to the client, the relics belong to a country that used to exist in the desert. Keep looking for more old crap buried in the sand!

help_texts.CLR: Deliver the plug-in chips to the Resistance member.
help_texts.DONE: After handing over the plug-in chips, the Resistance member seems happy, saying he'll introduce his family the next time you meet.
help_texts.FIN: However, they were attacked and killed by machines...
help_texts.RUN_1: Help the Resistance member in the city ruins retrieve the plug-in chips with classified data. Secure the following items from the machine lifeforms:
help_texts.END: It turns out the Resistance member was repairing broken YoRHa models and turning them into his new family.

help_texts.RUN_1: Retrieve the package from the cluttered storage area.
help_texts.CLR: Deliver the package to the client.
help_texts.DONE: You safely delivered the package to the client and admonished him for the state of the storage area. He claimed his supervisor is responsible and apologized...sort of.

help_texts.RUN_1: Retrieve the package from the even more cluttered storage area.
help_texts.CLR: Sort this mess out and deliver the package to the client.
help_texts.DONE: You gave the client the package and he kind of...sort of... maaaaaybe showed remote signs of coming close to being sorry. He still blamed his supervisor, however, and claimed he always has to clean up after her.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.RUN_1: The person in charge of the storage area has disappeared. A friend claims he went out to the desert camp to make a delivery and never returned. Put on your detective hat and figure out what happened.
help_texts.DONE: The person in charge of the storage area was stuck...in a storage facility. His supervisor had torn through the place like a tornado and ended up boxing him in. After he was rescued from his package predicament, the supervisor arrived and began teaching him how to organize packages more efficiently through the art of wanton destruction.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal

help_texts.RUN_1: The machine lifeform at the amusement park reception area gave you a stamp card and challenged you to fill it. Though the prospect doesn't sound particularly thrilling, there's apparently a magnificent prize awaiting anyone who collects every stamp. Take the challenge, visit each part of the amusement park, and fill that card!
help_texts.CLR: The stamp card is full. Head to the amusement park reception to collect your fabulous prize!
help_texts.DONE: You showed the stamp card and collected your prize. Afterward, the receptionist told you happiness existed only in the heart, and that the park was simply a mirror which reflected a person's true self.

help_texts.CLR: You defeated the menacing machines. Go check on the clown machine.
help_texts.DONE:
You successfully guarded the machine lifeforms. Apparently, they want to hold another parade somewhere else.
The clown was exhilarated at the parade's success, but he also seemed a bit sad that his efforts were not recognized by his peers.
help_texts.RUN_1: A clown at the city ruins wants to hold a parade as a sign of peace towards androids. However, some machines are...less than fond of this idea, so the clown needs protection. Make sure the machines holding a parade in front of the Resistance camp don't get hurt!
help_texts.FAIL_2: The parade has been wiped out. Talk to the clown again...and make sure not to mess up this time!
help_texts.FIN: You went to check on the clown and discovered a different machine lifeform who wants out of the dangerous parade business. Apparently, the parade you protected before disappeared in the desert while moving to their next venue...

help_texts.RUN_1: A man at the Resistance camp has lost contact with his comrades and asked you to find them. All members of the group wield dual weapons. Head to the source of their last known communication in the flooded city.
help_texts._1_1DONE:
You found the Resistance member's corpse in the flooded city. It looks like he came here in an attempt to escape a battle. You collected the dog tag from his fallen body.
You've received Resistance distress signals coming from the amusement park and the abandoned factory. Go investigate.
help_texts._1_2DONE: The Resistance member who sent the distress signal from the abandoned factory didn't make it. He was already dead when you arrived.
help_texts._1_3DONE: The Resistance member in the amusement park called out for help, but it was too late. He was already dead by the time you arrived.
help_texts.RUN_2: An urgent request for backup came through to the dead Resistance member's location. Head to the desert and save the Resistance!
help_texts.CLR: The Resistance member in the desert was killed by a tank-like machine lifeform. Bring the item you recovered from his body back to the man at the camp.
help_texts.DONE: Having received the mementos of his fallen comrades, the Resistance man gathered flowers from around the camp to commemorate their sacrifice.
help_texts.FIN: 9S erected a grave for 2B, putting to use the knowledge of funeral customs that he'd learned. He laid her to rest among beautiful white flowers so she would finally be at peace.

help_texts.RUN_1: The weapons trader at the Resistance camp can't perform repairs because of a broken maintenance device. It can be fixed with materials found in the center of the city ruins, but machine lifeforms in the area viciously attack anyone who comes near. Go secure the necessary materials by any means necessary.
help_texts.CLR: Deliver the materials to the weapons trader.
help_texts.DONE: With repairs complete, the weapons trader's weapons can be repaired. And while he's glad to return to work, he can't shake the feeling that the weapons he makes to protect his friends might actually hasten their deaths. Regardless, talk to the trader again to see if he's ready to start selling again.
help_texts.FIN: The weapons trader has reopened his shop. To express his thanks, he gives you some upgrade materials.

help_texts.RUN_1: You heard a machine lifeform in Pascal's village crying out for help. It seems her son sealed himself inside her house with an electronic lock and now refuses to come out. Find a way to open the door and drag the boy into the light.
help_texts.DONE: With the lock hacked and the door opened, the son reluctantly emerged. When asked why he sealed himself inside, he expressed fear of losing his connection to the network and becoming unable to understand what others were thinking. Thanks to your help—and a bit of persuasion from his mother—the incident was resolved without much trouble.

help_texts.RUN_1: The son who locked himself inside the house is at it again, this time with even stronger defenses. 9S must put his hacking skills to work getting the door open once more.
help_texts.DONE: With the door open, the son emerged once more and explained that on his last visit outside, he'd met another machine that he fancied. These thoughts both exhilarated and terrified him—though mostly terrified. Thanks to your help and additional persuasion from his mother, he decided to try living in the outside world once more.

help_texts.RUN_1: The former recluse's mother is troubled. As you might have guessed, her son has once again locked himself in the house, requiring 9S to hack in and save the day once more. This time, the electronic defenses are quite impressive!
help_texts.DONE: With the lock hacked and the door open, the son unhappily emerged. When asked why he sealed himself inside yet again, he insisted that he'd tried to exist in the outside world, but realized he was only happy when locked away from it. To this end, he divulged two new goals: To become the greatest, most reclusive recluse the world has ever known, and to invent a lock so formidable that none can bypass it.

help_texts.RUN_1: Something's wrong with Emil. Follow him to the desert.
help_texts.DONE: Replicated and sent into battle again and again, Emil knows all too well the pain of war without end. Unfortunately, no copy is a perfect duplicate—so some Emils eventually snapped and ran wild. His cherished memories brought him back to his senses, however.

availability.chapter_name: A Day in the Life of Pascal
